release_notes: Bugfix release mirroring the tester's verified server code (13-item addendum to the v1.3.0 audit). The report's play-pause toggles now READ real ad state: a new ad_entity_statuses endpoint answers internal campaigns from the DB and ad/adset/ad-campaign ids from the Graph API, one request per id because Graph v26 removed the ?ids= batch parameter (and enforces v26 behaviour regardless of the requested version) — failures now leave an error_log line instead of rendering every row ACTIVE. The frontend merge lets the server win (only in-flight toggles keep their optimistic mark), so a pause survives closing and reopening the report, and rows badge Disapproved / In review states the tree cannot show. FacebookAdsEngine pins IPv4 on every Graph call (the aggregator engine had missed the CAPI fix). install.sh enables php-fpm catch_workers_output so application error_log() output is no longer discarded, and schedules the rotation optimiser every minute. Panel: entity ids no longer leak into Landings' saved metric columns (the Offers guard ported); the Campaigns colgroup matches render order and the six fixed columns are locked with stale stored widths purged; copy-link reports through a transient toast (URL modal only when every clipboard transport fails) instead of window.alert; Postback Settings, Feedback and MCP copy through utils/clipboard so plain-HTTP panels stop failing silently; the Conversions Log modal no longer clips the date picker's Apply/Cancel row; the tz chip no longer wraps mid-date; floor_pct left the optimiser conditions UI (its default still applies).
